entry.title: New: RES24-003 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF TRAVEL, REGISTRATION AND RELATED EXPENSES, VALUED AT $2,780.99, TO THE CITY FROM THE UCLA INSTITUTE OF TRANSPORTATION STUDIES FOR THE DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF TRANSPORTATION SERVICES TO ATTEND AND PARTICIPATE IN THE LAKE ARROWHEAD SYMPOSIUM ON THE TRANSPORTATION-LAND USE-ENVIRONMENT CONNECTION IN LAKE ARROWHEAD, CALIFORNIA, OCTOBER 15-17, 2023.

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution as amended were adopted.
